<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scene version="1.2">
<project width="640" height="360" fps="24" duration="1" background="#000000FF"/>
<output id="still" path="out/frame_%04d.png" codec="png-sequence"/>
<assets><generator id="g-check" kind="checkerboard" width="2" height="2" scale="1" paint="#FF0000FF" paint2="#0000FFFF"/></assets>
<materials><material id="m-red" baseColor="#FF0000FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-green" baseColor="#00FF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-blue" baseColor="#0000FFFF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/><material id="m-yellow" baseColor="#FFFF00FF" unlit="true" doubleSided="true"/></materials>
<composition>
<layer id="l-default" asset="g-check" fit="fill" boxWidth="200" boxHeight="200" x="20" y="20"/>
<layer id="l-linear" asset="g-check" fit="fill" boxWidth="200" boxHeight="200" x="240" y="20" resample="linear"/>
<layer id="l-bicubic" asset="g-check" fit="fill" boxWidth="200" boxHeight="200" x="20" y="200" resample="bicubic"/>
<layer id="l-mitchell" asset="g-check" fit="fill" boxWidth="200" boxHeight="200" x="240" y="200" resample="mitchell"/>
</composition>
</scene>
